Usage: mslearn [options] [command]

CLI for the Microsoft Learn MCP server.

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  search [options] <query>       Search official Microsoft documentation through
                                 the Learn MCP server.
  fetch [options] <url>          Fetch a Microsoft Learn document in
                                 markdown-friendly form.
  code-search [options] <query>  Search Microsoft Learn code samples through the
                                 Learn MCP server.
  doctor [options]               Verify runtime, endpoint reachability, MCP
                                 connection, and tool discovery.
  setup [options]                Install agent discovery for the standalone
                                 Microsoft Learn CLI.
  remove [options]               Remove agent discovery for the standalone
                                 Microsoft Learn CLI.
  help [command]                 display help for command
